quote: Calling `setMain` or `resetMain` immediately changes the `Main` dispatcher globally.
note: 官方頁的 MainDispatcherRule 範例在 starting 裡 setMain、finished 裡 resetMain,且 setMain 範例用 try/finally 呼叫 resetMain;kotlinx README 說 Main 是全域替換,支持「不還原會汙染後面測試」。「單跑綠整套紅」字面未見,屬合理推論。

quote: There should only be one scheduler instance used in a test
note: 原文接著說要在所有 TestDispatcher 間共用,並建議把 testScheduler 傳給新建的 TestDispatcher,Caution 寫「Be careful not to create multiple schedulers」。

quote: If you create a `TestDispatcher` as a property of a test class, it won't take its scheduler from the `Main` dispatcher, as the `Main` dispatcher is only replaced before each test method is executed.
note: 官方明講類別屬性先初始化、會另建排程器,並建議先宣告 MainDispatcherRule 再讓其他屬性重用 mainDispatcherRule.testDispatcher,與型錄一致。

quote: If the test thread is never yielded during the execution of the top-level test coroutine, any new coroutines will only run after the test coroutine is done (but before `runTest` returns):
note: 官方範例 launch 後直接斷言會失敗,修法是 advanceUntilIdle/runCurrent 或 join,與型錄標準寫法一致。「init 不啟動改 stateIn(WhileSubscribed)」與「被誤修成 Unconfined」這兩小句頁面沒寫,為型錄自己的建議。

quote: Otherwise, `runTest` would keep waiting for its completion, causing the test to stop responding and eventually fail.
note: 官方頁用 backgroundScope.launch(UnconfinedTestDispatcher(testScheduler)) { ...toList(values) } 收永不完成的流,與型錄標準寫法逐字相同;另有「注入 backgroundScope 而非 TestScope」的 Tip(coroutines/test 頁)。UncompletedCoroutinesError 這個類名頁面未見。

quote: When testing a `StateFlow` created with such options, there must be at least one collector present during the test. Otherwise the `stateIn` operator doesn't start collecting the underlying flow, and the `StateFlow`'s value will never be updated.
note: 官方 Caution 與型錄後果完全一致,標準寫法(backgroundScope 空收集者)也是該頁範例。

quote: However, we generally recommend treating `StateFlow` as a data holder and asserting on its `value` property instead.
note: 同頁說 StateFlow 的值流是 conflated,快速連續設值時收集者不保證收到所有中間值,只保證最新一筆。與型錄的壞寫法、標準寫法、後果一致。

quote: If you create your own `TestScope`, you must call `runTest` on that scope within your test. There can only be one `TestScope` instance in a test.
note: 官方範例為 testScope.runTest { },與型錄標準寫法相同。

quote: Launching coroutines in tests without using `runTest` could potentially swallow exceptions,
note: detekt 頁有 GlobalCoroutineUsage(Report usages of GlobalScope.launch and GlobalScope.async)與 CoroutineLaunchedInTestWithoutRunTest 兩條規則;Android 頁建議注入測試 dispatcher/scope(In tests, replace real dispatchers with instances of TestDispatchers)。型錄的 SC TEST_006「三層都沒實作」未查,不在本次判定範圍。

quote: However, when using TestLifecycleOwner from the context of a coroutine (like runTest), this will cause the setter to hang, since coroutines should remain asynchronous.
note: 規則與標準寫法(suspend 版 setCurrentState)成立;但官方講的後果是 setter 內部 runBlocking 造成卡住(hang),不是「非主執行緒設狀態、不穩或崩潰」,建議把型錄後果改成「卡住」。

查了 Android 協程測試頁、kotlinx test README;MIGRATION.md(master 與 raw)與 API 參考頁的 run-blocking-test、TestCoroutineScope 都 404。Android 頁只說「uses the coroutine testing APIs introduced in kotlinx.coroutines.test 1.6」並指向遷移指南,以及 runBlockingTest 是「before version 1.6」的 API,沒有逐字寫「已棄用」與棄用等級,故棄用這個核心主張找不到權威原文。

quote: In general, you should have one invocation of `runTest` per test, and using an expression body is recommended.
note: kotlinx README 另寫「IMPORTANT: in order to work with on Kotlin/JS, the result of `runTest` must be immediately `return`-ed from each test.」,支持 JS 漏回傳的後果。「靜默跳過」字樣頁面沒有。

quote: Remember that `UnconfinedTestDispatcher` starts new coroutines eagerly, but this doesn't mean that it'll run them to completion eagerly as well.
note: 官方 yieldingTest 範例與型錄的壞寫法形狀相同(launch 內 delay 後斷言失敗)。

quote: If your test focuses on concurrency, prefer using `StandardTestDispatcher` instead.
note: 同段說 Unconfined 的行為跟正式環境不同;StandardTestDispatcher 段落列出 advanceUntilIdle/advanceTimeBy/runCurrent。

查了 developer.android.com testable-code(404)、fundamentals 頁、以及搜尋「Android inject Clock TimeSource System.currentTimeMillis test」,只找到部落格與 Mozilla/AOSP 程式碼提交,沒有官方文件逐字講「正式碼別直接讀系統時鐘、改注入 Clock」。kotlinx README 只說 testScheduler.timeSource 回傳使用虛擬時間的 TimeSource,沒講為何要注入。

quote: If the test needs to check multiple values, calling `toList()` causes the flow to wait for the source to emit all its values and then returns those values as a list. This works only for finite data streams.
note: 官方頁並建議用 backgroundScope 收永不結束的流,或 Turbine。注意:官方 first() 範例用在冷流;型錄壞寫法裡的 sharedFlow.first() 只有在沒有值可收時才會卡住,文件沒直接講,建議措辭收斂為 toList() 與永不發值的 first()。

quote: Failing to consume all events before the end of a flow-based `Turbine`'s validation block will fail your test:
note: README 另有「Received events can be explicitly ignored, however.」(cancelAndIgnoreRemainingEvents)。expectNoEvents 在 README 沒提到,屬型錄補充。

quote: Flow termination events (exceptions and completion) are exposed as events which must be consumed for validation.
note: README 有 awaitError() 用於等 Turbine 以 Throwable 結束,支持標準寫法;「錯誤訊息難讀」的後果頁面沒寫,範例用 RuntimeException 而非 IOException,不影響結論。
查了 Turbine README(trunk 與 raw)與 Android flow 測試頁,兩者都沒講 StateFlow 在 test{} 的第一個 awaitItem() 會是初始值。Android 頁的 Turbine 範例用的是 MutableSharedFlow。找不到權威原文。

quote: This is a wall clock time timeout that ignores `runTest`'s virtual clock time.
note: Turbine 的 timeout 是牆鐘時間;kotlinx README 寫「Timeouts are also susceptible to time control, so the code below will immediately finish.」,支持 withTimeout 在虛擬時間下被瞬間跳過。README 未直接提 test(timeout=) 參數名以外的細節,但與型錄一致。

quote: However, some APIs such as `viewModelScope` use a hardcoded `Main` dispatcher under the hood.
note: 同頁寫「If your code under test references the main thread, it'll throw an exception during unit tests.」並給 MainDispatcherRule 範例。訊息字串 Module with the Main dispatcher is missing 頁面未見,但不影響。

quote: Fakes don't require a mocking framework and are lightweight.
note: 官方表格寫 Fake 是 preferred,Mock 帶有對互動的期望、不符就讓測試失敗。「重構就紅、行為錯也綠」的後果字面沒寫,屬合理推論。型錄現成規則欄(DoNotMock*)我另查,規則確實存在。

quote: data classes represent pure data classes, so mocking them should not be necessary.
note: 規則頁接著說「Construct a real instance of the class instead.」。索引頁另列 DoNotMockSealedClass、ObjectClass、PlatformTypes、RecordClass,與型錄一致。Context 改用 ApplicationProvider 的部分見 Room 測試頁範例(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext)。

quote: Generally, you'll want to perform the operation with the side effect before the assertion,
note: 原文後接「and then assert that the result was what you expected.」;同頁說行為取決於斷言開或關。ExpensiveAssertion 說 Kotlin 的 assert 引數一律會被求值。

quote: Ignoring a test without a reason makes it difficult to figure out the problem later.
note: 原文接著要求寫明原因與何時能解決。

quote: using mechanisms in a test like an external `CountDownLatch` instead of the `waitUntil` APIs could behave unexpectedly, since the test clock won't be advanced.
note: 同頁寫外部工作(資料載入等)應使用 waitUntil(timeoutMs) { condition },並列出 waitForIdle、mainClock.advanceTimeBy。Thread.sleep 一詞頁面沒直接點名,以類比的 CountDownLatch 警告支持。
查了 Compose 動畫測試頁與同步頁。兩頁只說「set the autoAdvance property to false to control the clock」再用 advanceTimeBy 推進,沒有任何一句講 rememberInfiniteTransition 會讓測試永不 idle、卡到逾時。搜尋也只找到第三方技能頁,不能當出處。型錄自己已標「出處不全」,維持。

quote: Create and register these *idling resources* in your test so that they're taken into account when deciding whether the app under test is busy or idle.
note: 同頁前句說有些非同步工作在背景跑、測試並不知道;並給 composeTestRule.registerIdlingResource(idlingResource)。
查了 Compose 測試 APIs 頁、cheatsheet 頁(只有圖)、testing-quickstart(404)與搜尋 onNodeWithTag。官方頁範例大量直接用 onNodeWithText,也有 hasTestTag/onNodeWithTag,但沒有一句說「用文字或索引找節點會因改文案或語系而壞、應改用 testTag」。找不到支持原文。

quote: If you need to match a node of what would be the *unmerged* tree, you can set
note: 原文續為「`useUnmergedTree` to `true`:」;同節開頭「Some nodes merge the semantics information of their children.」,範例用 onNodeWithText("World", useUnmergedTree = true),與型錄標準寫法一致。「找到多個」字面未見。

quote: you may need to insert shadowOf(getMainLooper()).idle() calls to your test to drain the main Looper.
note: Robolectric 官方文章講 PAUSED 模式下主 Looper 的任務不會自動執行、要 idle();configuring 頁說未指定時跑 targetSdk,可用 @Config 指定。該 2019 文章描述 LEGACY 當時是預設,型錄說 PAUSED 現為預設,我未在這兩頁看到逐字確認,屬後來版本變動,建議另查 Robolectric 當前文件。型錄標「出處不全」,此判定僅就 idle 與 @Config 部分。

quote: you should create an in-memory version of your database to make your tests more hermetic
note: 官方範例 @Before 建 in-memory DB、@After 關閉。companion object 的 var、@FixMethodOrder 等其他壞寫法頁面沒提,只有 Room 這一部分被權威原文支持。

quote: `debugImplementation` is used here so that the empty activity definition that `FragmentScenario` relies on is accessible by the test target process.
note: lint 說明:FragmentScenario 建立的 Activity 必須存在於 runtime APK,故要 debugImplementation。重要差異:Android 官方 fragment 測試頁範例是 fragment-testing-manifest 用 debugImplementation、fragment-testing 本體用 androidTestImplementation,而型錄壞寫法把 androidTestImplementation fragment-testing 也列為錯,與官方範例相反,建議型錄只把「manifest 沒進 debugImplementation」當壞寫法。

quote: A hermetic test avoids all external dependencies, such as fetching data from the internet.
note: 官方原文接「This improves reliability and performance.」;MockWebServer README 說可重現 500 錯誤與緩慢回應等難以重現的情境。

quote: To avoid flakiness, we highly recommend that you turn off system animations on the virtual or physical devices used for testing.
note: AGP 文件說明 animationsDisabled 設為 true 時,命令列跑 instrumented 測試會帶 --no-window-animation;並註明對 Android Studio 內執行的測試不生效,型錄後果欄可補這一點。
